text: Tonight's dinner: Instant Pot Honey Garlic Chicken.
Sweet, sticky, and the pot does most of the work.
Honey, garlic, soy sauce, ketchup, oregano and parsley for the sauce. Sesame oil, chicken thighs, salt and pepper for the pot. Sesame seeds and green onions to finish.
Step one. Mix the honey, garlic, soy sauce, ketchup, oregano and parsley in a small bowl, and set it aside.
Step two. Put the Instant Pot on sauté, and add the sesame oil.
Step three. Season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper, and brown them for two to three minutes a side.
Step four. Pour in the sauce, then close and lock the lid.
Step five. Poultry setting, twenty minutes.
Step six. Turn it off, and let the pressure come down for about five minutes.
Last step. Plate the chicken, spoon the sauce over the top, and finish with toasted sesame seeds and green onions.
